gloss: going-out clothes; best clothes; company manners

definitions.explanation: Clothes kept for going out or visiting, as opposed to what one wears around the house; often used before の.
A more formal, polite way of speaking or behaving than one's usual, put on for strangers or special occasions; it can suggest the manner is not quite natural.

notes:
From よそ (somewhere else, other people's homes) and {行|ゆ}き (going): what one wears or how one acts when going out among others. Also written {余所行|よそゆ}き; the reading よそいき is also heard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- よそ{行|ゆ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧: going-out clothes
- よそ{行|ゆ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: one's public face
- よそ{行|ゆ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: formal, guarded language
